hypothesis: Returning neck_pitch toward its model metadata HOME before relying on the standing actor may avoid the extreme-neck input feedback seen in failed handoffs. Actual recovery is unproven.

settings.neck_target: model metadata HOME, about20degrees; not mechanical calibration zero
settings.standing_neck_readiness: Observed neck within20degrees of metadata HOME plus existing observed trunk tilt condition

selection_order: Run A first; prefer the simplest passing controller. Only if A fails adequate-coverage functional gates run B; only if B also fails run C. Each adjacent active comparison changes one controller feature.
before_freeze: Implement explicit head-target override before shared target projection/slew; raw policy history unchanged
CPU test disabled identity, model-HOME target, observed readiness, global freeze, per-model history and partial resets
Verify same complete physical model/noise and actual GPU zero-step boundary restoration
Freeze source/model hashes, fresh seed, budget, all original outcomes and complete videos
scope: Prospective new controller decomposition, not an extension of the closed neck-relief or45degree direct-handoff studies; no new success claimed.
additional_admission_gate: Preserve original8s recovery/3s hold scores, additionally require the same>=95percent requested/actual/overall stable hold through the final8..11s window; no early success may hide later instability.
